title: You Are A Badass At Making Money

questions.q: What belief about money does the book say is a harmful myth?
a: Money is only for the rich
questions.why: It calls the greed myth a societal belief.

questions.q: How does the author suggest you should treat money to improve wealth?
a: View it positively and as a tool
questions.why: Positive attitude toward money is recommended.

questions.q: What did Jim Carrey write to manifest his earnings?
a: A $10 million check dated three years ahead
questions.why: He wrote a $10 million check for future acting services.

questions.q: What personal goal does the narrator aim to achieve after the book?
questions.why: The narrator mentions a $100k savings goal.

questions.q: What does the book compare negative talk about money to?
a: A bad friend who talks you down
questions.why: Negative talk about money is likened to a bad friend.
